name: spanish-intake-skill
description: Conducts bilingual (English/Spanish) client intake and communication: turns Spanish-language intake notes or a voicemail transcript into a structured English intake summary for the file, and turns an English draft communication into a natural Spanish version — flagging any ambiguous translation for the attorney's confirmation rather than guessing.

interface.shortDescription: Bilingual English/Spanish client intake and communication drafting.
interface.longDescription: Conducts bilingual (English/Spanish) client intake and communication: turns Spanish-language intake notes or a voicemail transcript into a structured English intake summary for the file, and turns an English draft communication into a natural Spanish version — flagging any ambiguous translation for the attorney's confirmation rather than guessing.
defaultPrompt: Turn these Spanish intake notes into an English intake summary.
Translate this client email into Spanish.
